dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What are you hanging out here for?

dialogues.speaker: Jill
dialogues.text: Can you see Mr. Guard over there?

dialogues.speaker: Jill
dialogues.text: Me and Will wanna go and play with Ms. Edith at Windrise...

dialogues.speaker: Jill
dialogues.text: But Mr. Guard keeps following us and we can't get rid of him. I'm a bit scared, he looks like a bad guy.

dialogues.speaker: Jill
dialogues.text: That's why we ended up here, because we're trying to run away from him.
